_about: The comparison table on penthera.org. Every cell comes from a sourced page in docs/compare/ (or, for Cloudflare's cost and CVE scope, the research note in docs/research/ and the issue it cites). Each cell has at least one source. A cell's text may use {{BENCH_*}} values, filled in at build time. Change a page in docs/compare/ first, then this file.

penthera.t: Readable rules in the repo, with evidence and a confidence label. Models only propose fixes.

cloudflare.t: A language model hunts; fresh agents try to disprove each finding.

semgrep.t: Pattern rules: a rule language and 2,000+ community rules.

snyk.t: A curated vulnerability database, plus Snyk Code static analysis.

socket.t: Static analysis, then an LLM stage, with researchers confirming detections.

penthera.t: Routes, trust boundaries and secrets for Next.js, Express, Hono and Fastify.

cloudflare.t: Any source, including native code, protocols, cloud config, mobile and desktop.

semgrep.t: Many languages. CE works within one file; cross-file on the paid platform.

socket.t: Not its focus. SAST and secrets on the Enterprise plan.

penthera.t: URL scan: headers, TLS, CORS, auth, JWT, IDOR, OAuth, OpenAPI. Injection and fuzzing opt-in.

cloudflare.t: No. It forbids probing deployed endpoints.

snyk.t: Snyk API & Web (DAST), on Enterprise plans.

socket.t: Not its focus: it covers packages, browser extensions and AI models.

zap.t: Yes, deeper: many more active rules, spider and AJAX spider, an intercepting proxy.

penthera.t: What each package can do, an install firewall, typosquats, known-malicious versions (npm and Python), runtime advisories.

cloudflare.t: Reviews your build and release setup. Known dependency CVEs are out of scope.

semgrep.t: Semgrep Supply Chain with reachability, on the platform.

snyk.t: Known vulnerabilities and licenses, 13+ package ecosystems.

socket.t: Package behavior across many ecosystems, with registry-wide threat intelligence.

github.t: Dependabot alerts from reviewed advisories, and update PRs.

penthera.t: penthera agents: skills, MCP servers, hooks, permissions, plugins, checked locally.

cloudflare.t: Reviews AI and LLM attack classes in your app's code, not your tool config.

snyk.t: Snyk Agent Scan: MCP servers and skills. Sends metadata to Snyk's API, needs a token.

socket.t: An MCP server for package lookups; the firewall covers skills and models as downloads.

penthera.t: Applied on a local branch and re-scanned. Never pushes.

cloudflare.t: Recommends the smallest fix; does not apply it.

snyk.t: Fix pull requests through your SCM.

github.t: Dependabot security and version update PRs.

penthera.t: Yes. --offline limits traffic to the target you named.

cloudflare.t: Needs a coding agent and model usage on every run; network depends on your model provider.

semgrep.t: CE with local rules sends no metrics by default.

snyk.t: An account is required for the CLI.

socket.t: The CLI needs an API token; the firewall's free mode needs no key.

zap.t: Runs locally on Java 17+ or Docker.

github.t: Runs on GitHub; the CodeQL CLI also runs locally.

cloudflare.t: MIT, plus model usage on every run. One third-party test measured about $30 per run, on one target, by a party with its own tool.

semgrep.t: CE free. Platform free up to 10 contributors; Teams from $30 per contributor a month, per product.

snyk.t: Free plan (5 projects); Team from $25 a month.

socket.t: Free plan (1 seat); paid seats from $25 a month.

github.t: Dependabot free. Code scanning free on public repos; private repos from $19 to $30 per committer a month.

penthera.t: Precision {{BENCH_P}} (95% CI {{BENCH_P_CI}}) and recall {{BENCH_R}} ({{BENCH_R_CI}}), on {{BENCH_N}} findings in labs we wrote ourselves. Real-world accuracy is not measured yet.
Outside the source: the running app, what packages do, your agent config. Offline, with verified fixes and EU evidence.

cloudflare.t: Depth on your own code: logic and authorization flaws no rule describes, in many languages.

semgrep.t: Code analysis depth, cross-file dataflow, and your own rules.

snyk.t: Curated vulnerability data, containers and IaC, reachability, org features.

socket.t: Sees the whole registry, more ecosystems, human malware research.

zap.t: Dynamic testing depth, a manual proxy, logged-in crawls.

github.t: Known-vulnerability PRs, CodeQL depth, push protection, zero setup on public repos.
